# 1. Mira approves every new product name

Date: 2026-08-03

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-08-03; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「No product gets a name until I have said yes.」 — Mira Example, 2026-08-03

**Options considered:**
- a new product name is used only after mira approves it in writing (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** product-naming

A new product name is used only after Mira approves it in writing.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.

## Status

Superseded by 0014

## Decision

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

The report job runs once a week, on Monday morning.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.

Accepted

# 7. Customer data stays in the EU

Date: 2026-09-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-12; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Customer lists live in EU regions only, for every product I run.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-12

**Options considered:**
- every product stores and processes customer data in eu regions only (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** data-region

Every product stores and processes customer data in EU regions only. A hosted service is configured with an EU region before it is used.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.

# 24. No customer name is ever written to a log

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Accepted

## Context

While choosing a region for the hosted report-job queue, Mira added a rule that applies to everything she builds.

## Decision

**Words:** 「nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-21 (said for every repo and product, not just mira-app)

**Options considered:**
- no product or repo writes a customer's name into any log (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** log-pii

Nothing we build, in any repo or for any product, ever writes a customer's name into a log.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
